error: Quote-cache format mismatch silently produced a FAKE mark that was persisted to claude/live.
detail: QUOTES_PATH reader (run_ghost_oracle.py ~L127) expects a FLAT {symbol: price} map and does float(v) over the top-level values. cache/ghost_oracle_quotes.json on claude/live was written in the NESTED form {'asof':..., 'prices':{...}}, so float(dict) raises ValueError, the except swallows it, quotes={} , and the run falls through to 'No quotes available - open and mark will use entry prices'. Step 3 then marked all 297 open positions at their ENTRY prices, yielding equity=$29,700.00 / total_return=0.00% / SPY_price=0.0, and step 6 PERSISTED that point to the ghost curve (sha 17f0b99737ad). A fabricated 0.00% mark is indistinguishable from a real flat day in the curve.
impact: ghost_oracle_curve.json only; paper-only shadow, no live money. The bogus 2026-08-03 point was removed and the run redone with a flat quote cache -> equity $30,516.02 / +2.75% (sha 62faa08f1dd2).
action: Did NOT patch the running code. Defensive fix (accept both formats; fail loudly instead of marking at entry prices) committed to branch claude/adoring-brahmagupta-o9h4rs for operator review.
also: The nested file was dated 2026-07-28, so any ghost run between 07-28 and today that relied on the cache may have marked at entry prices. The 07-30/07-31 points carry non-zero returns and a real SPY_price, so those look genuine.

error: Follow-up to the quote-cache entry above: the FIRST corrected re-run was itself marked on STALE prices.
detail: After the failed run, run_ghost_oracle.py's own step-0 pantheon.hydrate() had already restored the 2026-07-28 quote cache over the freshly-written file, so flattening it produced 07-28 prices (SPY 740.76, AMZN 230.94) and a mark of $30,516.02. Caught by checking SPY against the session's actual close.
resolution: Quote cache rewritten from the session's real 2026-08-03 closes (SPY 757.63, AMZN 284.02), the stale 08-03 curve point dropped, and the mark redone with 203/203 (100%) coverage: equity $30,559.71 / +2.89% vs SPY +2.72% (sha 8c21ad53dd65). Curve verified free of duplicate dates.
lesson: A script that hydrates internally will overwrite any cache file staged before it runs. Stage inputs AFTER hydrate, or stub it.
